message: Someone left their silver sedan double-parked right in front of my building on Newbury Street for the third time this week. It is making it impossible to pull out of the street.
There is a car blocking the fire hydrant on the corner of Tremont and West Concord. It has been there since this morning.
A car is parked smack in the middle of the bike lane on Beacon Street near the Common. Can someone please move this before a cyclist gets hit?
Could someone come by the South End? There is an SUV parked directly in front of my driveway on Worcester St and I have a doctor's appointment in twenty minutes.
There is a vehicle with out-of-state plates parked in a resident-only spot on my street in Charlestown. We pay for these permits and there is never anywhere for us to park.
Someone is parked over the crosswalk at the intersection of Dorchester Ave and Andrew Sq. It is a major safety hazard for the school kids crossing.
A black Jeep has been sitting in a no-parking zone on Hanover Street for four hours now. It is blocking the delivery zone.
My driveway is completely blocked by a blue minivan on E 8th St. I cannot get my car out to get to work.
The person in this Honda has been parked on the sidewalk on Centre St for two days. People with strollers can't get past.
Seriously, another double-parked delivery truck on Washington Street. It is backing up traffic all the way to the station.
There is a car parked right in front of the hydrant on Commonwealth Ave. Please ticket them, it's a huge fire risk.
Could you send someone to check the resident parking on Marlborough St? A car has been there for days without a sticker and it's taking up a spot for someone who actually lives here.
The car parked in front of my garage on Saratoga St is preventing me from leaving. This is the second time this week.
Somebody is blocking the curb ramp at the corner of Summer and Washington. It makes it impossible for my neighbor to navigate their wheelchair.
There is a luxury car parked in a no-parking zone right by the hydrant near Fenway. It has been there since early this morning.
